ValidationRule.description: Blocks save when required fields are missing on Pricing Condition.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( ISPICKVAL(Market__c, ''), ISBLANK(L1_Channel_Code__c), ISBLANK(Product_SKU__c), ISBLANK(Valid_From__c), ISBLANK(Valid_To__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Required fields are missing. Please populate Market, L1 Channel Code, Product SKU, Valid From, and Valid To.
